verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick stack Q (Last Rites) procs and grave count uncontested; you win if you force E (Test of Spirit) trades before his ghouls snowball.

brief.thesis: Yorick wins by farming graves with Q (Last Rites) and flooding the lane with Mist Walkers, while you win by forcing spirit trades with E (Test of Spirit) that he can't easily dodge at range 900. Neither champion has reliable CC, so this is a pure damage-race and wave-state matchup decided by who controls when fights happen.

theirWindow.what: Decline the trade. His empowered Q (Last Rites) procs and ghoul damage add up fast; back off and let Tentacles from Passive (Prophet of an Elder God) poke him instead if he overextends.

yourWindow.when: Yorick's ghouls are on cooldown or dead
yourWindow.what: Hit E (Test of Spirit) immediately. Without ghoul backup he has no way to escape the spirit tether or out-damage the echo, so this is your highest-value window to land a full combo with W (Harsh Lesson) and Tentacle swings.

start.why: Picked in 57.3% of games and the higher-winrate option (48.1% over 449 games) — the extra sustain and damage let you contest E (Test of Spirit) trades without losing the all-in threshold.

boots.why: 68.9% pick rate and higher winrate (46.1% over 495 games) — Yorick's autos and empowered Q (Last Rites) hits are physical, so the reduction matters more than Mercury's Treads' tenacity here.

core.why: Most-run first core item (66.2% winrate in the top build path) — armor shred compounds with every Tentacle and E (Test of Spirit) echo hit, closing the damage gap by mid-game.
Second item in the dominant build path — the proc gives you a second AoE-feeling trade tool on top of W (Harsh Lesson) and helps you stick to Yorick before he can wall off with W (Dark Procession).
Third in both top build paths — the shield and bonus AD keep you alive through ghoul swarms and let you survive a bad E (Test of Spirit) trade.

situational.when: his sustain from Q (Last Rites) heals and Maiden-empowered attacks are outpacing your Tentacle healing
he's building toward all-in burst windows with R (Eulogy of the Isles) active
you want more burst on your W (Harsh Lesson) leap-in to punish him before ghouls arrive

runes.keystoneWhy: Picked in 45.7% of games with the top winrate (46.4%) — sustained poke damage and the health scaling reward you for standing in Tentacle range during the extended trades this matchup demands.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite carries the highest winrate (53.4%) despite lower pick rate (19.2%) — Ignite punishes his low early sustain before ghouls and graves stack, securing solo kills in your favored window.

playing.title: Count his ghouls before trading
playing.detail: Mist Walkers from Passive (Shepherd of Souls) scale his damage hard. If you see 2+ active, disengage; if none are up, that's your cue to all-in with E (Test of Spirit).

playing.title: Punish empowered Q windup
playing.detail: Q (Last Rites) has a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown and needs a landed hit to dig a grave. Step out of auto range right after he misses it to deny the grave and the heal.

playing.title: Use E before he resets ghouls
playing.detail: E (Test of Spirit) at range 900 outranges his kit when ghouls are down. Land it early in the trade so the echo damage ticks before he can summon backup.

playing.title: Don't walk into W (Dark Procession) blind
playing.detail: His wall has a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown and can cut you off from your Tentacles or escape route. Check for it before committing W (Harsh Lesson) deep into his side of the lane.

playing.title: Save R for his all-in post-6
playing.detail: R (Leap of Faith) hits all nearby enemies and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit — use it the moment he commits with ghouls up, since the extra Tentacle swings swing the fight your way.

playing.title: Respect the Maiden split post-11
playing.detail: Once he hits R (Eulogy of the Isles), his Maiden can occupy a side lane or push waves alone. Track his recall timing so you're not caught split-pushing into a 2-for-1.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1, 617-game sample); the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read based on the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Try to not get caught in Yorick’s (W)-(E) but if you get caught inside (W), use [Q] to get rid of (P) quickly and escape form (W). Use [E] while keeping your distance to harass and contest lane.
